status: Research framework, cost estimands and admission rule fixed; current full-development C requires Review. No successful autonomous deployment or final submission is claimed.
public_development_history: Two prospectively specified simplified controllers were rejected on their own complete training evidence. We subsequently retained the previously developed complete-policy constrained learner with an extra prespecified same-U guard. This is an open later development choice, not a retrospectively prespecified winner or fresh validation.

mathematics.growth: G_H=(log(real_terminal_wealth)-log100)/original_H, real wealth nominal/CPI; full lifetime H and historical peak preserved.
mathematics.loss: Maximum annual-endpoint real drawdown over original history; breach iff MDD-L>1e-12. Volatility separately describes ordinary fluctuation.
mathematics.objective: Within each beta, choose highest complete-training mean G_H among9 fixed control policies satisfying k<=min(k_B,floor(beta*n+1e-12)). Inner beta selection first maximizes admitted coverage, then conditional G; retained top-E/refit feasibility unchanged. This is not a claim of global optimality across all policies.

alpha.interpretation: Normative service reference, not elicited from questionnaire, law, data-identified preference or a certified future-risk upper bound.

mathematics.eta: Finite candidate policy-control index or risk_first; never called identified customer risk preference, a unique structural parameter or KKT multiplier. No new price grid.
mathematics.additional_guard: Only old already-selected final beta original inner automatic set U; require U>0, k(U)<=floor(.1*|U|+1e-12) and k(U)<=k_B(U). Same own-inner job/target/originalID. No alternative beta/eta/target or rescue of a previously rejected fit.

cost_and_benefit.exact_fee: C=c*sum(max((V-C)*w_i-x_i,0)); c=.0025, actual transfer counted once; deduct before return; initial allocation charged; no terminal liquidation.
cost_and_benefit.net_Q: Same state and joint chronological training fan, current action then branch-specific annual-reference continuation until own breach. Qg already contains current and later execution costs; no second subtraction.
cost_and_benefit.finite_score: Delta_net_Qg - original_H*eta*Delta_model_breach_probability. Restore iff score>1e-12; otherwise hold. Risk_first uses fewer events then positive netQg; never infinity*zero.
cost_and_benefit.economic_class: Optional restored trade with Delta_net_Qg>1e-12 is predicted net-growth improvement; nonpositive Delta_net_Qg restore must strictly reduce forecast breach count and is labelled risk reduction with growth cost. Neither is realized gain or calibrated true probability.
cost_and_benefit.cost_decomposition_boundary: Trade-once-then-hold admits exact gross-log-minus-current-log-fee decomposition. Branch-dependent future rebalancing/pending generally does not; current fee can change continuation. Do not construct a fictitious gross estimate by removing a fee from that adaptive path.
cost_and_benefit.initial: Q1 allocation is mandatory if the complete policy is admitted. It is a distinct inception convention, not evidence every initial trade passes a later optional gate.

current_static_full120.liquidity_interpretation: Normative target-bill floor applied jointly in all static fits; not a drifting live-cash reserve or withdrawal guarantee.

current_C_execution.interpretation: Inner evidence concerns the selected-beta learning procedure with its own inner targets/prices, not an independent test of one fixed final eta=.03. Difference10vs8 is not asserted statistically significant; rejecting it implements the declared conservative empirical reference rule.

diagnostics.critical_limit: One heldout repeat has5/24=20.83% events on admitted paths. Other common-auto comparisons also show more events/MDD than same-A B, alongside higher growth and lower fees. Guard is not a future safety guarantee. Repeats are dependent and zero-coverage risk isNULL.

safeguards.before_deployment_Review: No hypothetical B/all-bills financial return filled as the recommended automatic policy.
safeguards.after_actual_breach: Absorbing pending hold; continue actual returns/CPI and original peak/MDD/H, charge no further trades; no invented human-response time or recovery reset.
safeguards.liquidity_change: New actual cash need requests review; target weight drift alone is not a new forced sale rule.

what_is_not_finished: A robust C autonomous investment recommendation has not been demonstrated
Forecast conditional calibration and cross-fit service stability remain material weaknesses
No new paper rewrite, final121-180 reopening, CMT upload or regenerated submission ZIP in this phase
